title: Smoking and Cancer Risk in Men
subtitle: Risk reduction, screening, evidence, and practical prevention related to smoking and cancer risk in men.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from multiple large epidemiological studies and meta-analyses supports the causal relationship between smoking and cancer risk in men. Moderate evidence underpins the effectiveness of screening and cessation methods. Emerging evidence relates to long-term risks of newer nicotine delivery systems, such as e-cigarettes.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
